title: Relay Station Rewards
subtitle: Useful, not progression-skipping
summary: Relay rewards should support power, scanning, repair, and next-route preparation without bypassing later systems.
body: The relay cache loot table already contains power cells, circuit boards, scrap wire, energy cells, reinforced cable, scanner chance, filter chance, schematic chance, and relay logs.
This is strong enough to feel like a major route but should not replace later research, faction, or reactor rewards.
Manual smoke should confirm the cache is not empty, not duplicated, and not handing out late-game quantities too early.
